notes: Product behaviour, not a capture fault: while the camera heads to the photo wall or to one person, the product hides the other figures and the overlay labels/cards at once (first frame of the glide) and shows a small 「正在靠近」 chip; glides back to the overview show everyone from their first frame. In D-02 the vanish frame is 8.00 s (cast) and 17.00 s (all but 阿遥).

Product behaviour: the photos view frames four photos close (one row) and five photos wider (two rows, curtain and guitar in the foreground), so D-03a -> D-03b is a re-frame plus the new polaroid, not only a pop-in. In D-03s the re-frame happens on the same frame as the panel switches to the wall (6.50 s).

The desktop header shows the product's 「音乐探索 ↗」 pill (entry to Music Map) in every room frame; Music Map itself is never opened. Its box is 'headerMusicMap' in the D-02 marks if the edit wants to cover it with a sticker.

Playback is 4 % slower than real time (rig: 16 ms of virtual time per 60 fps frame). Waits shown uncut: 阿遥 accepting the exchange and 小满 accepting the greeting / replying take their real (seeded) times on the virtual clock.

The on-device AI answers in real time while the virtual clock is stepped, so 「AI 判断：人海」 appears 1 frame after the tap in D-03s (real latency here 0.15-0.3 s). The answer itself is the model's real output on the 人海 sample.

Clock: desktop takes use 2026-10-07 22:40 +08:00 (SHOTS.md, same as the P1 phone takes); the P2P3 phone tools default to 2026-10-09 22:30 +08:00, so on-screen times can differ between those clips (chat 22:40 here).
Holds change only on the product's line boil (every 8.9 frames on the virtual clock = 6.7 boils per second in the files); the edit's PUSH keeps holds moving as the storyboard asks.
Tap rings are the rig's doodle ring (yellow, ink outline, pink offset, 30 frames); there is no pointer arrow anywhere. Camera glides are started without a ring (the glide is the action).
problems: None blocking. Every clip: no frozen stretch over 9 frames (the product's line-boil cadence), no stutter inside camera glides (4 glides in D-02 + 1 in D-04: every frame moves, step ratio 0.98-1.01) or scrolls, no pointer, no half-loaded UI in the sampled frames, master and 1080 copy have identical frame counts.

QC heuristic false positives (still frame between two moving ones), checked frame by frame: D-02 16.98 s = a line-boil step two frames before the 阿遥 glide starts; D-06 11.55 s = two discrete UI updates two frames apart (your bubble lands, then its 已保存 status). Neither is a stutter.

Eased scrolls end with a final 2-3 CSS px snap: Chrome draws these panels on a whole-CSS-pixel grid even at DPR 8/3, so sub-pixel ease tails would otherwise repeat frames. D-03 and D-05 were re-recorded with this fix (first versions had 1-device-pixel judder at scroll ends); the earlier files were deleted.
The model-download check before D-03 waited for nothing (the demo already warms the model at boot, before any page listener); harmless: the AI answered 1 frame after the tap.

D-03b and CUT-03 were re-taken in their own world (take D03B) so the 5 s save toast 「已分享给本场成员」 is gone before the hold starts; D-03a / D-03s come from the previous D-03 world (same build, same visitor, same sample).
